digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI workflow on GitHub Actions
propositions: Gerrit Verified macOS execution latency increased from 15–20 minutes to 30–40 minutes between commits ceea743 and current main, driven by test growth (+4.1k default tests, +91,205 test lines) and production-scale sleeps/waits in unit tests, not mutation testing

Unit tests execute expensive blocking operations (120s JIRA field timeout, five real 5s sleeps, 25s retry backoff, 15s process timeouts) at full production scale when unit-test-specific fast-clock or zero-budget alternatives would preserve coverage

Mutation testing contribution is statistically rejected as direct cause: present in only 5/62 post-mutation runs, never on critical path (0m measured addition), and skipped runs averaged 36.5m wall versus active mutation runs 33.0m

macOS test subprocess/APFS workload becomes nonlinear under organization runner contention (GitHub Free org limits: 20 total jobs/5 macOS), amplifying deterministic test growth; queue median 0.72m and mean 4.04m conceal median execution 27.0m beneath p90 queue 13.53m

Wiki corpus test (test_wiki_render_corpus.py:54) recomputes process-local lru_cache once per xdist worker instead of once per session, adding 321.6–495.6 aggregate seconds across five tests in default tier

Seven linked tickets decompose coverage-neutral remediation targeting fake clocks, injected sleepers, immutable AST caching, wiki cache recomputation, import benchmark optimization, fixture reuse, and test timing window shrinkage without parallelism changes
